## Description

Explain what changed and why. Link the relevant issue (for example, `Fixes #1512`).

## Type of change

- [ ] Contract / Rust
- [ ] Frontend
- [ ] Scripts / TypeScript
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Tests

## Local checklist

- [ ] `cargo test` or `npm run backend:test` passes (contract changes)
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes (frontend changes)
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes (frontend changes)
- [ ] `npm run build` passes (frontend changes)
- [ ] `npm run typecheck:scripts` passes (script changes)
- [ ] `npm run test:scripts` passes (script changes)
- [ ] `node check-doc-links.mjs` passes (documentation changes)
- [ ] New public contract functions have tests
- [ ] No secrets or `.env` files are committed

## Acceptance criteria

List the issue acceptance criteria and confirm each is met.

## Test evidence

Add commands run and relevant results.
